name: Device Simulator
description: View/control simulators and paired iPhone/iPad. Apple simulators: macOS 15+, Apple Silicon, full Xcode/runtimes. Android: Mac/Windows x64/Linux x64; confirm downloads/licenses. Physical: Mac, Xcode 27+, Developer Mode; text/AX need signing. Shared sidebar, input, screenshots and apps.
whenToUse: iPhone/iPad hardware and iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Vision Pro, Android simulators: connect devices, view/control screens, install/launch apps, input, screenshots, UI inspection and logs. Use devices first and verify outcomes.

environment.description: Read-only iOS and Android environment, runtime and model discovery. platforms reports readiness and errors. Use devices first for existing devices. Missing Android components are installed through settings after the user reviews sizes and licenses; this tool downloads nothing. Includes iOS, tvOS and visionOS (xrOS identifiers) runtimes and device types.

devices.description: Physical coordinate input, gestures and screenshots prepare live control automatically; control.ready describes XCTest text/accessibility readiness only. Call first: list private devices. tasks/thisTask describe selection only; activeTasks/thisTaskActive describe task activity in the last 15 minutes. usage is active/idle/unknown; operation describes running work. Prefer this task’s recent devices. tasks=0 does not mean free; inspect running devices with unknown activity. Listing does not renew activity.

device.description: Physical: live touch/screenshots auto-connect. Text/AX/apps: connect signs a runner (optional teamId); poll connect_status until ready. disconnect preserves phone/apps. No boot/shutdown/erase/delete/rename/heal or idle power-off. Simulators: create from environment (7–12GB), prefer reuse; inspect boot timeouts. Cold boot muted; audioEnabled=true opts in. audio queries; audioEnabled changes output, Apple live, Android requires consent to exit apps and restart=true. No host volume/mic changes. iOS memoryMode: saving default, standard full acceptance, minimal scoped tests; see manual. Switch after shutdown; check mode/verified/limitations (service switches only). shutdown keeps data; erase/delete only on request. activity/release: task use 15min, nonexclusive, lost on worker restart. Android import_media: absolute image/video path ≤128MiB; check copied/scanRequested/path. Inspect partial outcomes and binding/screenshot errors; never repeat completed writes.

app.description: Physical: install accepts signed iphoneos .app only, synchronously returns done; info.matchesLocal=null. launch/terminate/open_url need ready control. Simulators: absolute .app/single APK, no AAB/splits. Identical installs skip; Apple may sync changes, signature changes fully install. Apple info+appPath: verify=auto rechecks trees and reuses full evidence or returns job; full checksums, none metadata. install_status waits on install/verification jobs, default85s. Only matchesLocal=true confirms; null never warrants reinstall. launch relaunches by default; arguments/env Apple-only. Check appLaunched/viewer.previewOpened; failed viewing retries observation, never launch. Android failures retain launchError/appTerminated/execution. terminate stops; uninstall deletes app/data; open_url may show prompts. Container errors do not mean absent. BUSY names device/job. Apple platforms must match; compatible iPad on Vision fully installs. Switching does not move apps. See viewer and workflow manual.

screenshot.description: Physical: latest shared video frame, source=live-video, capturedAt and frameAgeMs; an idle screen may reuse its last frame. No signing or simulator mask. Capture the upright screen; supported Cindy hosts attach an image, otherwise open path with an image tool. Default: 1 pixel=1 view point; grid=true adds labelled coordinates, region crops, scale 2–3 adds detail (divide coordinates by scale and add region origin). iOS adds corner/Dynamic Island masks by default. Android returns a rectangular framebuffer without added physical corner/cutout masks; it does not verify physical occlusion or safe areas. corners is iOS-only; Android accepts omitted/false and rejects explicit true before reading the screen. capturedAt dates the frame; screenshotAttached=false means open path. Reuse adequate returned evidence to check the goal.

describe_ui.description: Physical devices use XCTest accessibility. Use screenshots and coordinates for custom-rendered screens; no OCR fallback is promised. Read the on-screen elements (accessibility tree). Default: a compact list in reading order with role, text, id, frame and center in view points (tap the center directly). Filter with query/role; x,y returns what is under a point; mode=full returns the whole tree. Games and custom-drawn UIs without accessibility get the text read off the screen instead (source=ocr), with positions; use screenshot for icons without text. OCR failure is an error, not evidence that no text is visible. tvOS/visionOS return OCR text lists in every mode (including full and x,y point queries), without accessibility trees or element IDs. Apple TV coordinates are for observation; operate with remote buttons.

tap.description: Physical: continuous HID input, with XCTest text/id lookup retained. Default observation is a post-input live screenshot; ui/both still read accessibility. Never replay uncertain input. Simulators: system touch without a window or App injection; works with locked Mac. Use exact text/id (role,nth optional), or screenshot view-point x,y. Observe again after rotation. count=2 double-taps; duration≥0.5 holds. Default observe=ui; screenshot/both attach images. until waits for text; settle 0–5s, simulator default0.6s. Post-input observation has a 12s budget, plus up to15s for until; execution survives observation failure. Retry only observation. Vision maps screen coordinates to one-hand pinch; Apple TV uses press. Games without accessibility use screenshots/OCR on simulators; physical devices have no OCR fallback. Reuse returned evidence to verify the goal.

gesture.description: Physical: continuous swipe/drag/pinch/pan, followed by a live screenshot. Incremental touch: kind=drag, phase=begin/move/end/cancel, points=[[x,y]] (1–2 contacts). Pass the returned gestureId after begin. Observe/reverse while held; begin/move renew a 30s lease. Always end/cancel. No edge/scroll_to/spatial. Simulators: swipe from/to or direction; drag with hold; pinch center/from_spread/to_spread; pan from/by. iOS also supports edge/scroll_to. Vision spatial: gaze, drag depth in metres, pinch scale, rotate angle, camera tilt/pan/orbit/dolly/move/reset. by has two axes: degrees for tilt/orbit, metres right/up for pan; move uses [right,up,back] metres. Negative dolly moves forward. Screenshot after camera movement. Apple TV uses press. Coordinates are view points. observe/until/budgets follow tap; settle 0–5s. Observation failure never warrants replaying input.

type_text.description: Focus a field first. Physical supports Unicode text and Enter/Backspace/Tab via XCTest, method=auto only; no clear, shortcuts or clipboard modes. Simulators: auto pastes in ordinary apps; games without accessibility use US-key input. paste accepts Unicode; type is limited to300 characters; keys supports chords, clear selects/deletes. Enter may submit; tap blank space to dismiss editing. iOS hardware-key input hides the software keyboard; cleanup after ~3s does not guarantee restoration. method=touch uses a focused field’s paste menu, excludes clear/keys; iOS/Android only. Android Unicode uses clipboard, type ASCII, cmd maps Ctrl. Vision auto pastes. TV auto/type needs an English input method, ≤300 US characters, no Unicode/clipboard. observe/until follow tap; failed observation preserves input, retry observation only.

press.description: Physical: Home uses live HID, release-input releases Agent-held contacts; volume buttons retain XCTest. No held hardware buttons. iOS and Android: home, lock, power, volume-up, volume-down, app-switcher, swipe-to-app-switcher, swipe-to-home, pull-down-to-notification-center, release-input. iOS only: action, pull-down-to-lock-screen. Android only: back, shake; the notification-center button expands notifications, not the lock screen. Unsupported buttons fail before input. duration (0–10 seconds) holds hardware keys only. release-input releases stuck keys and stops repeats without restarting or closing Apps. Apple TV: up/down/left/right/select/back/menu/home/play-pause/volume-up/volume-down. Vision Pro: digital-crown (home alias). Both support release-input.

wait_for.description: Physical devices support text/id appearing or disappearing, at most 30 seconds; not stable/log. Return once a condition holds (up to 90 s) instead of fixed sleeps and repeated screenshots. text or id appears (gone=true: disappears; in games, the text read off the screen); stable=seconds: the screen changes less than tolerance (percent of pixels, default 0.5) for that long, optionally only within region; log=regex: a matching line in the app's log (with bundleId). screenshot=true attaches the screen. If it does not happen: met=false, the reason and the current screen; for game animation, a suggested tolerance. Images use the call’s remaining time budget; failure or exhausted budget preserves the wait result with screenshot.error. Request screenshot separately if needed. goalMet mirrors met; false means the condition was not met, not a passing acceptance check.

capture.description: Not available on physical devices. Capture before an optional action (tap,gesture,press,type_text,open_url,app_launch), then for seconds≤15. Returns deduplicated time-labelled contact sheets and frames; supported hosts attach sheets≤130KB, otherwise open paths. For transitions, toasts, loading and animations. Fixed orientation/size/panel required, checked before/after action and capture; no per-frame rotation tracking. All stages share one deadline. Action starts only after a complete first frame and screen confirmation. Failure before action: captureError, execution=not_executed. Later capture failure retains action/actionError and execution; inspect executed/unknown outcomes, never replay blindly.

set_state.description: Not available on physical devices. Simulator orientation, posture, appearance, contrast, text_size, network profile/offline/clear or latency/bandwidth/loss, location, status_bar and privacy action/service/bundleId. iOS-only hinge, location=clear and privacy reset; permissions terminate apps. Android: no hinge/arbitrary loss; location coordinates enable, clear rejects before writes. Offline/100-loss disables Wi-Fi/data; other profiles enable, clear restores. Permissions require API23+ and app declarations; photo/media switches at API33, motion API29+. Preflight rejection causes no writes. One deadline: failure retains applied fields/appliedSteps and stateError; partial progress is not not_executed. Inspect before replay. Rotation is confirmed only from evidence; null means unconfirmed. TV/Vision omit orientation/posture/status_bar; other fields runtime-dependent. Details in workflow manual.

logs.description: Physical devices collect up to 600 seconds of unified logs with macOS log collect. process/match/limit are supported, not bundleId or crash summaries. System log access may be required. Read recent logs: last_seconds defaults to 120, limit to 150, level to default; error/info/debug also supported, match is regex. iOS default includes ordinary Default messages, not a warning threshold; iOS includes device/process crash summaries; diagnostic failure retains logs with crashesError; crashes=false skips diagnostics. Android default means warning+; Android returns raw lines filtered from at most the latest 3000 logcat records: main+crash buffers, or main only with crashes=false; no iOS crash summaries. Android bundleId/process scopes only to the current exact PID, excluding logs/crashes from previous PIDs after exit/restart; absent processes return processRunning=false. Empty logs do not prove no crash. For historical evidence, explicitly omit process scope and inspect device logs.

heal.description: Not available on physical devices. Repair only after the user accepts the platform-specific restart: iOS restarts SpringBoard in the private device set and terminates running Apps; Android reboots the entire emulator and ends all Apps. After Android reboot, wait for devices to report Booted before continuing. Try press(release-input) first for stuck keys.

viewer.description: Physical viewer and Agent share live HEVC and continuous HID. No team ID; first use prepares a pinned private Python runtime. Text lookup/input still need signed XCTest. Open/close task view; check previewOpened. Closing preserves devices/apps and active Agent gestures. Switching selects only. Simulators: touch/keyboard/wheel/pinch, clipboard replacement, app/file install (may overwrite), rotate/shake/screenshots/start/stop. Android import ≤128MiB, silent WebM ≤5min/128MiB. iOS advanced tools change location/motion/status/network, camera and notifications; logs/video may contain app data. Maps use proxied OpenStreetMap. Disclose effects before opening; opening performs none. Loopback only. Binding/context errors preserve completed results. outcome=partial: follow nextAction; retry viewer/observation only, preserve app. See manual for limits.
